# MiTL Studio Newsroom

> Official press releases from MiTL Studio (https://mitl.studio), the live conversation and community studio founded by Keith Bilous. MiTL Studio produces Mornings in the Lab, a two-hour live show every Monday to Friday that has never missed a day: 800+ episodes and 300+ guests. "We're your morning accountability partner."

Each release below has its own page with the full text.

## Press releases

- [The Morning Daypart Has Moved to YouTube. Nobody Is Programming for It. — Mornings in the Lab Files Thesis on the Biggest Underserved Audience in Streaming](https://newsroom.mitl.studio/releases/may-2026-morning-daypart-thesis/) (May 2026): MiTL Studio releases its first formal thesis on the structural opportunity reshaping morning television: legacy network shows have lost nearly half their viewers, the audience has migrated to YouTube and streaming, and almost no one is programming a daily live morning show built…
- [Mornings in the Lab Surpasses 1,000 Consecutive Live Hours Without Missing a Single Day, Cementing Position as YouTube’s Longest-Running Independent Morning Show](https://newsroom.mitl.studio/releases/march-2026-1000-consecutive-live-hours/) (March 2026): Mornings in the Lab with Keith, Jon & Friends has surpassed a milestone that no other independent creator has reached in the morning daypart: 1,000 consecutive hours of live morning programming — without missing a single day.
